# GX

> GX is the quality layer for agent-written code: capture coding sessions, organize changes into reviewable stacks, and publish richer review context.

## Core workflow

```bash
git add <files>
git commit -m "describe this change"   # a GX hook records the revision
git status
git push                               # the pre-push hook captures sessions + publishes
```

## Docs

- [Overview](/docs): Product model — sessions, revisions, stacks, review bundles
- [Get started](/docs/getting-started): Install, auth, gx init, first revision, build a stack
- [How it works](/docs/how-it-works): What GX captures, stacks vs commits, Git export
- [CLI](/docs/cli): gx init, gx review, gx doctor, and setup commands — with flags and examples
- [MCP Setup](/docs/mcp): add-mcp connect, Executor integration, the gx_review tool, plain-git save workflow
- [GitHub PRs](/docs/github): PR Summaries and @gx chat (paid / trial)
- [Troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting): Common errors, environment variables, uninstall
- [API](/docs/reference/api): GX Cloud HTTP APIs
